# ECN-2026-004 Change notice - Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L1-SB02

Reason for change
- Replace the current lubricant specification for the Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #2 with the approved shop lubricant listing. This change clarifies maintenance procurement and standardizes lubricant use across P3 line assets. See OEM recommendation referenced in SB-1033 and procedural alignment required by SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-05.

Affected items
- EQ-P3-L1-SB02 lubrication point set: all grease and oil service points previously covered under generic site stock are affected. The lubricant to be used for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 is CFW-LUB-278 part number. Update maintenance records and parts lists to reflect CFW-LUB-278 part number in lieu of unspecified items.

Implementation
- Maintenance supervision will update the EQ-P3-L1-SB02 preventive maintenance instructions to specify CFW-LUB-278 part number at all applicable lubrication steps. Reference SB-1033 for technical feed recommendations and incorporate procedural steps from SOP-P3-L1-02 and SOP-P3-L1-05 where lubrication is documented.
- Procurement shall add CFW-LUB-278 part number to the P3 consumables catalogue and ensure availability for scheduled work. Warehouse will flag existing stock for segregation until disposition is determined by maintenance leads.
- Technicians will record the use of CFW-LUB-278 part number on the equipment history record for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 and note the ECN identifier when closing work orders.

Approvals
- Engineering review completed and cross-checked against SB-1033, SOP-P3-L1-02, and SOP-P3-L1-05. Approval signatures required from Maintenance Manager, Plant Engineering, and Procurement Buyer per ECN control rules. Preserve signed ECN with equipment history for EQ-P3-L1-SB02 and update the controlled document index.
